about_the_game:
• Customize your character

Choose your hair, eyes, nose and skin or just randomize it

  • Drink and Pee

Your right trigger controls the angle and your right stick the direction. It will turn yellow when it's about to run out.

  • Movement Speed, Climbing and Sliping

Your movement speed is progressive and you will not be able to run immediately if you stop or get stunned. 

You can climb everything except rocks.

If you slip, only a flat surface will stop you.

  • Grab and Throw / Bury

Grab and throw whatever you see on the map, each element behaves in a different way

You can also bury, if you do it in the air it will launch you up

  • Stun

Stun your enemies by throwing or burying things, the effect will be different depending on what you throw at them

  • Damage and Abilities

Eat the fruits to gain abilities. All fluids hurt opponents, some powers can be combined with stage elements in creative ways.

You will lose when all your hair is gone and all your skin falls off.

Up to 4 player local (for now).

This game is being developed completely by a single person, all the assets, animations, programming, sound and other elements that make it up have been made by Emmanuel Crispi.

short_description: Control creatures with gross abilities and compete in absurd frantic battles in this action platformer game. Piss, spit, shit and make your friends taste every fluid you can get on them before they do the same to you. Try not to lose your hair and skin to the corrosive fluids of the other creatures!
